minutes_text:
Library Board
  MINUTES – March 27, 2024
The Inglewood Library Board met on March 27, 2024, via Zoom. Board Member Pat Douglas called the
meeting to order at 4:34 pm.
Roll Call

Present:
  Joyce Garner – District 1 Board Member
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy City Manager
  Kerri Arroyo – Library Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Management Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Board member Douglas made a motion for the approval of the minutes for October 25, 2023.
  Board Member Garner seconded the motion.

  All in favor, motion passed.

Library Report

  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo welcomed onboard Board Member Garner and gave updates on
  programming, customer service, and professional development. She shared some pictures from the
  Inglewood Unified School District job fair, which had over 500 participants; from art therapy/charm
  bracelet making at the Library, Build a Bear workshop came to the Library, which included over 300
  participants and 200 kids making a bear; the Crenshaw Library Branch held a graduation ceremony
   for a group of special needs students from West LA College; Main Library Christmas tree and polar
  bear area; transformation for Halloween in the Library with over 700 trick-or-treaters; Jesse Byrd who
  is a children's author came to the Library in November; Plantable bookmarks were made and are an
  introduction to the IPL's "Seed Library"; 2024 Summer Reading Program; Pins for the Library with
  library mascot "Tommy the Turtle" to come; Seed Program; New library van for when library
  renovation starts; New Library Cards; and a Catalog search bar on the Library's homepage that was
  requested by one of the library board members.

  Deputy City Manager Harjinder Singh updated the board members on the main library renovation.
  He shared pictures of the new entry of the Library, the new elevator that meets the handicap
  accessible code, the Patio, the interior and exterior of the building, the floor space, bathrooms, maker
  space, classrooms for different activities, study rooms, story time room; community room and
  meeting rooms.

  Board member Garner asked, How do you know that's a handicapped elevator?

  Deputy City Manager Harjinder Singh stated that it's a larger elevator that accommodates disabled
  patrons.

  Board Member Douglas asked if it was the same area where the current stairs are.

  Deputy City Manager Harjinder Singh stated no.

  Board Member Douglas asked if the overpass going to Inglewood High School will go to the building
  once it is built.

  Deputy City Manager Harjinder Singh stated that he thinks it will land on the opposite side of the
  sidewalk.

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  Board Member Castillo thanked Library Manager Kerri Arroyo and Deputy City Manager Harjinder
  Singh for the fantastic work that is getting done and said that it is the right time for the Library and
  district to collaborate; he also thanked them for the long meeting and was very excited to be part of
  the library board.

  Board member Garner thanked everyone for welcoming her to the board and for being so kind,
  showing her the Library, and making arrangements for her to be at the Library and attend the Zoom
  meeting. She's very excited to be on the board and is here to support the Library with whatever she
  can.
   Board Member Douglas asked Kerri where Tommy is and if he can come to the Library. Board
  member Douglas also thanked us for the great work and extraordinary meeting.

  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo told the board that Tommy had been hibernating for four months. He's
  confused; he woke up last week and went back to sleep again. He sleeps in their garage and will
  wake up in April or May. And yes, he has spent a day at the Library for the last three years and is
  very exhausted after one full day of work.

With no further comments, the meeting adjourned at 5:46 pm.
